entries.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
entries.answer: 対象はローカルskill-supply-chain packageのrecovery evidence sources、shared failure domains、cross-layer attestations、independence assessmentsとre-entry linkage。外部システムへの攻撃、live monitor、credential、実運用の自動遮断・復旧・再開は対象外。
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: 成功は、challenge protocol、challenge run、observed perturbation、detection、grade impact、governance routingが参照解決され、未実行・未検証・失敗・common-cause露出・monitor evasionはfail closedとなること。challenge件数や成功率を品質、安全性、実際の防御力、権限として扱わない。
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: 価値のある最小単位は外部red-team基盤ではなく、制御challengeの計画・観測・影響を再現し、未実行・失敗・回避・共通障害をgovernanceへ送るローカルruntimeである
